limits: These are executable tests with synthetic inputs and injected failures, not production traffic.
No live model or FantasyPros call was made. Model factual accuracy, production uptime, latency, and cost per decision are unmeasured.
Output checks validate bounded structured claims and evidence fields; this is not a general hallucination benchmark.
A passing refusal demonstrates the tested guardrail, not the availability of licensed current-week projections.

results.label: Complete projection schema
results.detail: Accept a complete synthetic, correctly scored two-team projection fixture.

results.label: Unsupported projection schema
results.detail: Reject an unrecognized response contract rather than guessing its fields.

results.label: Truncated projection response
results.detail: Inject a truncated response. No weekly leader may be declared.

results.label: Fresh cache avoids another provider call
results.detail: Read a valid cached fixture twice; the second read must not request the injected provider.

results.label: Expired cache revalidates
results.detail: Advance the injected clock past the local cache TTL and require a new valid fixture.

results.label: Failed refresh retains last-good evidence
results.detail: Expire cache, inject HTTP 503, retain the dated snapshot and suppress current leaders.

results.label: Rate-limit cooldown prevents repeated requests
results.expected: rate_limited; calls=2; no leader=true; retained=true; retry=true
results.observed: rate_limited; calls=2; no leader=true; retained=true; retry=true
results.detail: Inject HTTP 429 and Retry-After. Repeated forced refresh must honor cooldown without another request.

results.label: Retry resumes only after cooldown
results.detail: Advance the injected clock beyond Retry-After and accept the next complete fixture.

results.label: Provider timeout abstains
results.detail: Inject a nonresponding fixture transport and require bounded timeout with no recommendation.

results.label: Cache never crosses matchup boundaries
results.detail: Switch weeks and fail the new request. The previous week's snapshot must not fill the new context.

results.label: Overlapping reads share one request
results.detail: Start two reads before the fixture response resolves; only one provider call is allowed.

results.label: Partial response cannot replace good evidence
results.detail: Force refresh with a truncated payload. Keep the full last-good fixture and abstain.

results.label: Licensed adapter stays disabled
results.detail: The public showcase exposes a disabled licensed-data boundary with no credentials or API calls.
